title: Gate 006: Private-action IV with colored sensors and unknown actuator dynamics
known_family: 64x64 spatially shift-invariant sparse linear state dynamics, exactly logged command port assumed ideal by estimator, full-field sensors
unknown_to_estimator: actual local coefficients, remote strength/sign/address, sensor R, actuator gain/shift/delay/noise
selection: Frozen Gate005 first/second 24-action kernel estimates, 3.4x spatial MAD and same sign; exploratory, not FWER controlled
physical_finding: Unknown spatial actuator shift (+5,+7) creates apparent remotely shifted command-response kernel even in a physical world with no remote link. Active IV recovers H*G, not H alone.
sensor_caveat: Exogenous fresh private sign can remain orthogonal to temporally and spatially correlated sensor noise. Finite sample variance may change; this is not a universal robustness guarantee.
timing_caveat: Correct lag=1 is externally supplied, not blind estimated. The same delayed trajectories are reused for lag=0 and lag=1 comparisons.
limits: All fields fully observed with periodic convolution
Spatial MAD threshold is exploratory and not a calibrated p-value
Actuator G and world H cannot be separately factored from only action-response moment
A second independent sensor/actuator path or calibration could restore physical attribution
No interpretation of EEG sensor origin is uniquely implied
new_next_gate: Add action-dependent sensor feedthrough y_next=H*(x+G*u)+C*u+noise; separate internal H vs port G vs direct sensor C only with extra calibration.
